name: The Great Silver Deceiver
summary: Galvan the Ancient in Stranglethorn asks you to bring him Mithril Bars and Truesilver Bars. The request centers on a deceiver whose name promises more than the details here reveal.

sections.title: A Request in Stranglethorn
sections.body: Galvan the Ancient asks for metal in Stranglethorn. You are to bring him forty Mithril Bars and five Truesilver Bars; the request names a great silver deceiver, but gives no further account of it.

faq.answer: Galvan the Ancient asks you to bring the bars in Stranglethorn.
Galvan asks for forty Mithril Bars and five Truesilver Bars.

faq.q: Where do I bring the bars?
faq.answer: Bring the bars to Galvan the Ancient in Stranglethorn.

attribution: In-game quest text: The Great Silver Deceiver
